question: How many sales reps do we have?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_reps FROM application.people WHERE issalesperson

question: What is our total invoiced revenue before tax to date?
SQL: SELECT SUM(extendedprice - taxamount) AS revenue_before_tax FROM sales.invoicelines

question: How much stock on hand do we have in total across all products, in units?
SQL: SELECT SUM(quantityonhand) AS units_on_hand FROM warehouse.stockitemholdings

question: What is our total gross margin in dollars on everything we have invoiced?
SQL: SELECT SUM(lineprofit) AS gross_margin FROM sales.invoicelines

question: How many orders arrived late? Count an order as late when its confirmed delivery date is after the expected delivery date on the order.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM sales.invoices i JOIN sales.orders o ON o.orderid = i.orderid WHERE i.confirmeddeliverytime::date > o.expecteddeliverydate

question: What is our total accounts receivable right now, meaning what customers still owe us?
SQL: SELECT SUM(outstandingbalance) AS accounts_receivable FROM sales.customertransactions

question: How much do we currently owe our vendors in total?
SQL: SELECT SUM(outstandingbalance) AS accounts_payable FROM purchasing.suppliertransactions

question: How many products need to be kept refrigerated?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refrigerated_products FROM warehouse.stockitems WHERE ischillerstock

question: What promotions do we have on record? Show each promotion's description with its start date and end date.
SQL: SELECT dealdescription, startdate, enddate FROM sales.specialdeals ORDER BY startdate

question: Which products are below their reorder point right now? Show the product name, the units on hand and the reorder point.
SQL: SELECT si.stockitemname, h.quantityonhand, h.reorderlevel FROM warehouse.stockitemholdings h JOIN warehouse.stockitems si ON si.stockitemid = h.stockitemid WHERE h.quantityonhand < h.reorderlevel ORDER BY si.stockitemname

question: How many customer orders came up short and had the remainder moved to a backorder?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_backorder FROM sales.orders WHERE backorderorderid IS NOT NULL

question: How many of our products are made in Japan?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_made_in_japan FROM warehouse.stockitems WHERE customfields::json->>'CountryOfManufacture' = 'Japan'

question: How many customers are in each customer category? Show the category name and the number of customers, and leave out categories with no customers.
SQL: SELECT cc.customercategoryname, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid GROUP BY cc.customercategoryname ORDER BY customers DESC, cc.customercategoryname

question: Which products are in the USB Novelties group? Just give me the product names.
SQL: SELECT si.stockitemname FROM warehouse.stockitems si JOIN warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sg ON sg.stockitemid = si.stockitemid JOIN warehouse.stockgroups g ON g.stockgroupid = sg.stockgroupid WHERE g.stockgroupname = 'USB Novelties' ORDER BY si.stockitemname

question: For each supplier we carry products from, show the supplier name and how many products we carry from them.
SQL: SELECT s.suppliername, COUNT(*) AS products FROM warehouse.stockitems si JOIN purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = si.supplierid GROUP BY s.suppliername ORDER BY products DESC, s.suppliername

question: Who is the main contact at each supplier? Show the supplier name, the contact's full name and the contact's email address.
SQL: SELECT s.suppliername, p.fullname, p.emailaddress FROM purchasing.suppliers s JOIN application.people p ON p.personid = s.primarycontactpersonid ORDER BY s.suppliername

question: How many customers do we deliver to in each sales territory? Show the territory and the number of customers.
SQL: SELECT sp.salesterritory, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers c JOIN application.cities ci ON ci.cityid = c.deliverycityid JOIN application.stateprovinces sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = ci.stateprovinceid GROUP BY sp.salesterritory ORDER BY customers DESC, sp.salesterritory

question: What is our stock on hand worth for each product color, valued at last cost price? Show the color name and the value, and leave out products with no color.
SQL: SELECT c.colorname, SUM(h.quantityonhand * h.lastcostprice) AS stock_value FROM warehouse.stockitemholdings h JOIN warehouse.stockitems si ON si.stockitemid = h.stockitemid JOIN warehouse.colors c ON c.colorid = si.colorid GROUP BY c.colorname ORDER BY stock_value DESC, c.colorname

question: Which purchase orders are still open? Show the purchase order number, the supplier name and the expected delivery date.
SQL: SELECT po.purchaseorderid, s.suppliername, po.expecteddeliverydate FROM purchasing.purchaseorders po JOIN purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = po.supplierid WHERE NOT po.isorderfinalized ORDER BY po.purchaseorderid

question: How many invoices went to customers in each buying group? Show the buying group name and the number of invoices, and leave out customers who are not in a group.
SQL: SELECT bg.buyinggroupname, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM sales.invoices i JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customerid = i.customerid JOIN sales.buyinggroups bg ON bg.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid GROUP BY bg.buyinggroupname ORDER BY invoices DESC, bg.buyinggroupname

question: How many units moved through the warehouse under each type of stock movement? Show the movement type name and the total quantity, with the sign as recorded.
SQL: SELECT tt.transactiontypename, SUM(t.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM warehouse.stockitemtransactions t JOIN application.transactiontypes tt ON tt.transactiontypeid = t.transactiontypeid GROUP BY tt.transactiontypename ORDER BY tt.transactiontypename

question: How much have we paid each supplier in total? Show the supplier name and the amount paid as a positive number, for suppliers we have paid.
SQL: SELECT s.suppliername, -SUM(st.transactionamount) AS amount_paid FROM purchasing.suppliertransactions st JOIN application.transactiontypes tt ON tt.transactiontypeid = st.transactiontypeid JOIN purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = st.supplierid WHERE tt.transactiontypename = 'Supplier Payment Issued' GROUP BY s.suppliername ORDER BY amount_paid DESC, s.suppliername

question: How many customers do we have?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sales.customers

question: How many countries are in Europe?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS countries FROM application.countries WHERE continent = 'Europe'

question: What are the phone number and website of our supplier Contoso?
SQL: SELECT phonenumber, websiteurl FROM purchasing.suppliers WHERE suppliername = 'Contoso, Ltd.'

question: What is the recommended retail price of the USB rocket launcher (Gray)?
SQL: SELECT recommendedretailprice FROM warehouse.stockitems WHERE stockitemname = 'USB rocket launcher (Gray)'

question: How many temperature readings above 4.5 degrees has our refrigerated delivery vehicle logged?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM warehouse.vehicletemperatures WHERE temperature > 4.5

question: How many order lines are still waiting to be picked?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpicked_lines FROM sales.orderlines WHERE pickingcompletedwhen IS NULL

question: How many products have a lead time longer than 14 days?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM warehouse.stockitems WHERE leadtimedays > 14

question: What is the highest credit limit we have given any customer?
SQL: SELECT MAX(creditlimit) AS highest_credit_limit FROM sales.customers

question: What was our gross margin in dollars in each calendar year, going by invoice date? Show the year and the margin.
SQL: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)::int AS year, SUM(l.lineprofit) AS gross_margin FROM sales.invoices i JOIN sales.invoicelines l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many orders did we take in each month of 2015? Show the month number and the number of orders.
SQL: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orderdate)::int AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders WHERE orderdate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND orderdate < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: By what percentage did invoiced revenue before tax grow from 2014 to 2015, going by invoice date? Round to one decimal place.
SQL: WITH y AS (SELECT SUM(l.extendedprice - l.taxamount) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate) = 2014) AS r14, SUM(l.extendedprice - l.taxamount) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate) = 2015) AS r15 FROM sales.invoices i JOIN sales.invoicelines l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid) SELECT ROUND((r15 - r14) * 100.0 / r14, 1) AS growth_pct FROM y

question: How much money did we receive in customer payments between January 1 and March 31, 2016?
SQL: SELECT -SUM(ct.transactionamount) AS payments_received FROM sales.customertransactions ct JOIN application.transactiontypes tt ON tt.transactiontypeid = ct.transactiontypeid WHERE tt.transactiontypename = 'Customer Payment Received' AND ct.transactiondate BETWEEN DATE '2016-01-01' AND DATE '2016-03-31'

question: How many cold room temperature readings went above 4.5 degrees in February 2016?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM warehouse.coldroomtemperatures_archive WHERE temperature > 4.5 AND recordedwhen >= TIMESTAMP '2016-02-01' AND recordedwhen < TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01'

question: Who were our top 5 customers by invoiced revenue before tax in 2015? Count each store on its own, not rolled up to its head office. Show the customer name and the revenue.
SQL: SELECT c.customername, SUM(l.extendedprice - l.taxamount) AS revenue FROM sales.invoices i JOIN sales.invoicelines l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customerid = i.customerid WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY c.customername ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customername LIMIT 5

question: Which sales rep brought in the most invoiced sales including tax in 2015? Show their full name and the amount.
SQL: SELECT p.fullname, SUM(l.extendedprice) AS sales_including_tax FROM sales.invoices i JOIN sales.invoicelines l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid JOIN application.people p ON p.personid = i.salespersonpersonid WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY p.fullname ORDER BY sales_including_tax DESC, p.fullname LIMIT 1

question: What are our top 10 products by units invoiced, all time? Show the product name and the units invoiced.
SQL: SELECT si.stockitemname, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_invoiced FROM sales.invoicelines l JOIN warehouse.stockitems si ON si.stockitemid = l.stockitemid GROUP BY si.stockitemname ORDER BY units_invoiced DESC, si.stockitemname LIMIT 10

question: What share of our invoiced revenue before tax comes from refrigerated products? Give it as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
SQL: SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.extendedprice - l.taxamount) FILTER (WHERE si.ischillerstock) * 100.0 / SUM(l.extendedprice - l.taxamount), 2) AS refrigerated_share_pct FROM sales.invoicelines l JOIN warehouse.stockitems si ON si.stockitemid = l.stockitemid

question: Which employee has picked the most orders? Show their full name and the number of orders picked.
SQL: SELECT p.fullname, COUNT(*) AS orders_picked FROM sales.orders o JOIN application.people p ON p.personid = o.pickedbypersonid GROUP BY p.fullname ORDER BY orders_picked DESC, p.fullname LIMIT 1
